name: Charles 2.0
source:
What happens when you wake up with no memories, but find that you're actually the president? Can you put on a convincing enough display to fool the public, reporters, and even your spouse? Or will you stumble and accidentally expose some of the government's greatest secrets?

[from [url=https://wolfscade.itch.io/charles20/devlog/74099/are-you-a-convincing-president]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你醒来失去所有记忆，却发现自己其实是总统，会发生什么？你能装得足够像，骗过公众、记者，甚至配偶吗？还是会失足，意外暴露政府最重大的秘密？

[来源：[url=https://wolfscade.itch.io/charles20/devlog/74099/are-you-a-convincing-president]itch.io[/url]]
